name: Ragefire Chasm (Classic)
summary: Ragefire Chasm threatens Orgrimmar from beneath its streets, where troggs have broken into the tunnels. The fiery caverns also shelter a cult whose plans reach beyond Durotar.

sections.title: A Hidden Peril
sections.body: Ragefire troggs have surged into the volcanic tunnels beneath Orgrimmar. They pushed up from deep fissures and now threaten the city's foundations. Magatha Grimtotem, a tauren, tried to make peace with them, but the troggs answered with violence. Their tunnels run below the stone streets and fortified towers, leaving Orgrimmar at risk if the creatures keep digging upward.

sections.title: The Searing Blade
sections.body: The Searing Blade works beneath Orgrimmar in service to the demonic Shadow Council. Taragaman the Hungerer, a felguard, leads the cult with Jergosh the Invoker, an orc warlock, and Bazzalan, a satyr. They seek to undo all that Thrall's Horde has established in Durotar. Warchief Thrall keeps watch on their activities, hoping their overconfidence will expose higher leaders within the Shadow Council.

faq.q: Where is the entrance to Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: You reach Ragefire Chasm through the Cleft of Shadow, a subterranean canyon deep within Orgrimmar. The entrance lies near the tent of Neeru Fireblade, an orc warlock.

faq.q: Why are there troggs beneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Ragefire troggs surfaced from ancient, deep cavern systems beneath Durotar and broke into the volcanic depths under Orgrimmar. Their invasion threatens the capital's structure and its people, and they have refused every attempt at peaceful containment.

faq.q: Why does Thrall allow cultists to live under the capital?
aliases: why is searing blade under orgrimmar
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall knows the cultists are beneath Orgrimmar and keeps them under close watch. He hopes they will reveal the identity and whereabouts of the Shadow Council's true leaders.

faq.q: Who leads the cultists inside the chasm?
faq.answer: Three figures command the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm: Taragaman the Hungerer, a formidable felguard; Jergosh the Invoker, an orc warlock; and Bazzalan, a satyr.

angles.text: As Horde, you defend your homeland by securing Durotar's bedrock and rooting out demonic collaborators beneath the capital.
As a tauren, you know Magatha Grimtotem sent emissaries to seek peace with the invading troggs. Their bloody refusal showed that diplomacy could not stop these underground beasts.
